name: XlFileValidationPivotMode
description: Specifies how to validate the data caches for PivotTable reports.

constants.name: xlFileValidationPivotDefault
constants.description: Validate the contents of data caches as specified by the PivotOptions registry setting (default).

constants.name: xlFileValidationPivotRun
constants.description: Validate the contents of all data caches regardless of the registry setting.

constants.name: xlFileValidationPivotSkip
constants.description: Do not validate the contents of data caches.
